title: ChiLow Round Counts Against Meet-in-the-Middle Attacks
summary: The presented attacks reach 9-round ChiLow-32 and 8-round ChiLow-40; whether 10-round ChiLow-32 and 9-round ChiLow-40 prevent them remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: $R_{32}=10$ and $R_{40}=9$ should suffice to prevent the presented MitM attacks.

scope.domain: Meet-in-the-middle cryptanalysis of the ChiLow-32 and ChiLow-40 block-cipher variants.
parameters: R32: the round count for ChiLow-32, proposed as 10
R40: the round count for ChiLow-40, proposed as 9
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether the proposed round counts suffice to prevent the presented meet-in-the-middle attacks.

progress.summary: The paper reports attacks on 9-round ChiLow-32 and 8-round ChiLow-40, then conjectures that increasing them to 10 and 9 rounds, respectively, should prevent the presented attacks. Their sufficiency is not established.
citation_labels: Eran Lambooij et al., Meet-in-the-Middle Attacks on Full ChiLow
